events.title: Employee is fatally injured in slip and fall walking on berm…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Jb Rivera & Sons Roofing Co Inc. Waikoloa, HI. At 11:30 a.m. on February 13, 2025, Employee #1 was working as a roofer assistant and was transitioning from a loose rock dirt berm to a sloped concretedriveway. Employee #1 lost his balance and slipped due to loose rocks on the dirt berm and fell onto the concrete driveway, sustaining fatal injuries.

events.title: Employee dies of multiple injuries when pinned by falling sh…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Island Home Building Materials Inc. Waipahu, HI. At 8:00 a.m. on January 23, 2025,Employee #1, working as sales worker for a building materials supplier, was standing inside a 40-foot shipping container. Employee #1 was assisting a coworker who was operating a forklift unloading wooden crates of countertops weighing over 3,000 pounds. While still inside the container, a crate of countertops that were double stacked on each other had shifted and pinned Employee #1, causing multiple fatal injuries.

At approximately 7:53 p.m., Company #7, including Employee #1 through Employee #4, arrived and began conducting a primary search on the second floor while another company searched the first floor. events.title: Employee is killed when struck by vehicle
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Elite Parking Services Llc. Honolulu, HI. At 4:45 p.m. on October 11, 2024, Employee #1 was walking from her boyfriend's car back to the parking attendant booth when she was struck by a vehicle exiting the lot. She sustained multiple blunt force injuries and was fatally injured.

The two employees were in the process of rebuilding the drill head when the coworker attempted to reverse rotate the drill head from the cab while Employee #1 manually manipulated the drill head with a heavy-duty break-out wrench. Whileperforming this task, the coworker heard Employee #1 say something, and upon looking from inside the…

events.title: Employee is killed when crushed by residential elevator
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Access Lifts Of Hawaii Inc. Waipahu, HI. At 10:40 a.m. on December 5, 2023, Employee #1 was working for an elevator installation and maintenance contractor. Employee #1 was troubleshooting and performing maintenance on a two-story residential ADA elevator. The elevator was on the second floor at the time of the incident, and Employee#1 disengaged the safety interlock on the outer elevator door on the first floor while the elevator was on the second floor. Employee#1 propped the outer door open with a tool bag and entered the elevator…

events.title: Employee is killed due to workplace violence
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Doh - Hawaii State Hospital. Kaneohe, HI. At 5:20 p.m. on November 13, 2023, an employee was working in an office set-up for nurses and staff in the "P" cottage. The employee was stabbed to death by a patient/resident living at the facility.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by tree stump
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Hawaii Hardwood Services Llc. Pahoa, HI. At 1:15 p.m. on August 14, 2023, an employee was making a back cut with a chainsaw on an Albizia tree that was in the process of being felled. The tree cut branches hit a stump in the drop zone, resulting in the stump kicking upwards and towards the side and then on top of the employee. The employee was crushed to death.

events.title: Employee dies of carbon monoxide poisoning
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: K.S.C.W. Ltd. Honolulu, HI. At 3:00 p.m. on April 10, 2023, an employee and his friend were using a gas-powered pressure washer to strip paint off the interior surface of a brick wall. After an unknown amount of time, the employee lost consciousness and was driven to Queens Medical Center, where he was pronounced dead. The friend was later transferred to Kuakini Medical Center. According to the medical examiner, both individuals had been diagnosed with carbon monoxide poisoning.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from elevation
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Jane Seymour Construction. Kaneohe, HI. At 11:00 a.m. on March 16, 2023, Employee #1 was dismantling the post for the second floor roof structure in the master bedroom. Employee #1 had first dismantled the exterior wall stud that supported the roof structure. Then, Employee #1 climbed up on a single stage metal frame scaffold and stood on a 19-inch wide scaffold platform 41.6-inches high above the floor. Employee #1 then started to saw cut the opposite or interior side of the roof structure, when the roof structure had detached from…

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from residential rooftop
events.description: 1 worker death. Lahaina, HI. At 2:00 p.m. on May 23, 2022, an employee was roofing a residential structure without wearing a fall arrest harness or any other fall protection system. The employee slipped and fell from the roof to the concrete ground and suffered fatal fractures to his back and neck.

events.title: Employee is killed in trench collapse
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Peterson Bros Construction Inc. Honolulu, HI. At 10:00 a.m. on January 29, 2022, an employee worked in a seven-foot-deep trench to take measurements with a laser. While working a section of the trench wall collapsed, engulfed, and trapped the employee. The employee was killed by internal injuries received.

events.title: Employee dies by drowning while operating lawn mower
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Silver Falls Stables Llc. Kilauea, HI. At 10:45 a.m. on December 13, 2021, an employee was riding on a lawn mower, when he lost control of the mower. The employee and the mower slipped down a 20 foot embankment. The mower flipped and landed on top of the employee, pinning his head under water. The employee drowned.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by falling forklift fork
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Kenworth Hawaii Llc. Hilo, HI. At 4:30 p.m. on December 8, 2021, an employee was standing by the left fork of aSkytrack 8042 JLG that was retracted and tied back with a 3/16 diameter rope to the backrest of the forklift. The right fork was in its natural working position about 5 feet high above a new engine on a metal shipping pallet. The employee was going to connect the lifting chain to the engine and to the right fork in order to lift the engine out of the shipping pallet when the rope snapped and the left fork struck him…

At 9:45 a.m. on November 26, 2021, Employee #1 was repairing the grit chain inside the pre-aeration tank #4, a permit-required confined space with atmospheric and engulfment hazards. Employee #1 and Coworker #1, both from the maintenance team, were tasked to enter the permit space to repair the plastic grit chain and bracket collection system via a confined space entry permit. They were the authorized entrants. In additional to the entrants, the employer also designated Coworker #2 (from the…

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by falling load of steel comp…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Ten Ten Events Inc. Honolulu, HI. At 7:30 p.m. on July 29, 2021, an employee was using a pallet jack unloading a container of steel scaffold components when he lost control of the pallet jack. As a result, the load fell on the employee causing blunt force trauma to his head and chest, killing him.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by knuckle boom
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Bob'S Equipment Llc. Honolulu, HI. At 10:30 a.m. on July 19, 2021, an employee was working on the hydraulic system for a knuckle boom that was above him. The employee loosened three of the four bolts on the hydraulic inner boom cylinder load holding valve with his ratchet tool and was beginning to loosen the fourth bolt when the overhead crane's boom struck him and pinned him to the equipment. The employee died from his injuries.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall to tarmac
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: U.S. Aviation Services Corp. Honolulu, HI. At 1:15 a.m. on March 14, 2021, an employee removed a guardrail from an elevatedwork platform in order to close an exterior airplane door. The employee did not properly attach his harness to the retractable lanyard connected to the overheadanchor point. The employee fell approximately 15 to 18 feet to the concrete tarmac and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed when struck by scout truck
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Honolulu Disposal Service Inc. Honolulu, HI. At 2:30 a.m. on January 8, 2021, an employee was walking to his scout truck when he was struck by a coworker leaving the yard in another scout truck. The employee sustained head injuries and was killed.

events.title: Forklift operator is struck and killed by unstable load
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Theophyllus Inc. Honolulu, HI. At 2:00 p.m. on December 8, 2020, an employee was operating a forklift when an unstable 2,000 pound load of glass fell from the forklift and pinned the employee between the load and the flat bed of a truck. The employee suffered blunt force trauma which killed him.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall into unguarded sump pump pit
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Doonwood Engineering Inc. Honolulu, HI. At 11:30 a.m. on November 27, 2019, Employee and a coworker removed a sump pump from a pit to service the pump. The employee and coworker removed the steel plate covers and did not place barricades around the pit while the work was conducted to prevent falling in. The coworker stepped away for a few minutes andleft the employee to ensure no one came near the pit. When the coworker returned, he found the employee had fallen twelve feet into the pit and was partially submerged and unresponsive.…

events.title: Two employees sustain severe burns when caught in fire, one…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Green Recycling Llc. Kapolei, HI. At 3:00 p.m. on October 31, 2019, two employees were cleaning and removing auto debris from the area. Employee #2 was using a DeWalt DWE305 Reciprocating Saw to cut a gas tank from a car that was up on a rack when a fire started behind him. Employee #1 grabbed a fire extinguisher from a forklift and attempted to extinguish the fire; however, the force of the extinguisher blew burning material into a second area that also caught on fire. Employee #1 sustained severe burns over his body and was…

events.title: Two employees sustain burns during fire in recycle yard, one…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Green Recycling Llc. Kapolei, HI. At 3:00 p.m. on October 31, 2019, an employee was moving auto debris into an area when a fire broke out. Employee #2 was using a DeWalt DWE305 ReciprocatingSaw to cut a gas tank from a car that was up on a rack. Employee #1 tried to put out the fire using an extinguisher but the force of it blew burning material into another area which caught on fire. Employee #1 sustained burns on various parts of his body and was killed. Employee #2 was also burned and placed into amedically induced coma.

events.title: Employee is killed during rollover of road roller
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Dmac & Son'S Llc. Lahaina, HI. At approximately 8:26 a.m. on September 23, 2019, an employee was operating a Bomag, model 124 DH Roller road roller. The road roller overturned and the employee was crushed. He was found on his side with the road roller tipped over. The employee was killed by blunt force head trauma sustained during the rollover of the vehicle.

events.title: Employee falls from ladder after receiving electric shock an…
events.description: 1 worker death. Honolulu, HI. At 12:15 p.m. on July 27, 2019, an employee was connecting new wiring for a new exterior spot light to the existing conduit box and wires using an extension ladder approximately 12 feet above the ground. The employee was working on the new installation while the power was energized using a non-insulated 7 inch Tekton wire stripper and was shocked for about approximately 15 seconds before falling from the ladder. The employee landed on his back and his head on the concrete ground.

events.title: Employee and passenger drown when kayak capsizes
events.description: 1 worker death. Kaaawa, HI. At 11:30 a.m. on March 28, 2019, an employee was kayaking on the ocean with 3 children passengers approximately 150 yards off shore. The employee and one passenger drowned with the kayak capsized. Life preservers were not available. available.

events.title: Employee is killed while operating riding lawn mower
events.description: 1 worker death. Kalaheo, HI. At 1:15 p.m. on May 18, 2018, an employee was operating a riding lawn mower. The employee was engaged in grounds keeping activities and was riding a Scag Cheetahmower, model number: SCZ61V-36 BV. The employee lost control of the mower while travelling 35 feet down a 20 degree slope. The mower and the employee fell over a six foot retaining wall, resulting with the tractor flipping over and pinning the employee beneath. He was was not wearing a seat belt and died 30 minutes after the incident.

events.title: Employee's golf cart runs into wall, killing him
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Us Security Associates Inc. Aiea, HI. At 8:21 a.m. on May 7, 2018, Employee #1 was seated in the passenger seat of a golf cart. The driver came to a stop and parked in front of a store. The driver went inside of the store, leaving the cart running. Employee #1 inadvertently stepped on the accelerator pedal of the golf cart, which released the parking brake, causing the cart to move forward and hit a building wall. Employee #1 waspartially ejected forward with his legs still in the cart. He suffered head and neck injuries, and was…

events.title: Employee driving forklift and is killed when thrown from ope…
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Native Imports Llc. Honolulu, HI. At 12:40 p.m. on May 3, 2018, an employee was driving a forklift and turned to the left. The employee was thrown from the operator's cab and crushed his neck and head at the top of the ROPS frame. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee falls through an unguarded roof skylight and is kil…
events.description: 3 worker deaths. Employer: Environmeteo Services Inc. Honolulu, HI. At 12:45 p.m. on March 29, 2018, an employee was walking on a metal roof of an existing one story warehouse building. The employee fell through an unguarded fiberglass skylight. The employee fell 16 feet to the concrete floor. A coworker went to look for the employee, found the employee, and called for help.The employee died.

events.title: Employee falls out of bulldozer cabin and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Covanta Honolulu Resource Recovery Venture Llc. Kapolei, HI. On April 6, 2017, an employee was operating a bulldozer crushing and moving garbage. The employee fell out of operator's cabin of bulldozer as it was movingsharply downhill. The employee was crushed and suffered blunt force trauma to hips and legs. The employee was killed by heavy equipment, either by tracks of his dozer, or wheels of loader working nearby. There was no evidence of the employee wearing a seatbelt.

events.title: Employee is Killed When Crushed by Fallen Crate
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Xpress Trucking Inc. Honolulu, HI. At 11:00 a.m. on August 4, 2016, a supervisor and Employee #1 were using a forklift (make: Toyota; model: 7FGCU25; serial: 68596) to transport a wooden crate filled with plate glass from a warehouse to a loading dock. The crate measured 109 inches long by 30 inches wide by 63 inches high. As the supervisor operated the forklift, Employee #1 stood on its forks along with the crate to help stabilize the load. At 9:50 p.m. on July 25, 2016, an employee and his co-worker had both just endedtheir shift and clocked out and they both walked off of the property and went totheir vehicles. Both employees went into their separate vehicles and a coworker drove the employee, and the employee waved good bye to the coworker as he drove out of the parking Lot. The coworker said that the employee was still in his truck and he was writing in his log book. The employee on the outside of the property and climbed over…

events.title: Employee is killed in watercraft training accident
events.description: 1 worker death. Honolulu, HI. At approximately 10:45 a.m. on June 14, 2016, a two man team, an employee and a coworker were conducting Rough Ocean Water Rescue Training with personal watercraft (PWC) equipped with sled. Upon cresting a wave, the PWC operator looked back and saw an employee, his rescue crew person, who had been riding on the sled, face down in the ocean. Apparently, the employee was killed from bluntforce trauma to his head, cervical fractures and damage to his spine.

events.title: Employee drowns in ocean during a swim test
events.description: 1 worker death. Honolulu, HI. At approximately 9:30 a.m. on February 18, 2016, Employee #1, a life guard, was completing a lifeguard open water swim test to complete annual requirements to recertify as a lifeguard. He swam approximately 250 yards in the ocean and was swimming towards the shore to complete the 500 yard swim test when the instructor noticed he was not moving. The instructor and other lifeguards swam out and brought Employee #1 to shore and began CPR. Employee #1 drowned. #1 drowned.

events.title: Employee falls from roof and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Island Pacific Energy Llc. Honolulu, HI. At approximately 1:30 p.m. on September 23, 2015, an employee was using a 100 foot measuring tape to get the dimensions of the area on the roof of the building for the installation of Photovoltaic (PV) panels. The employee fell off the east edge of a 4-story commercial roof equipped with 1-foot parapet approximately 44 feet above ground level. The employee was killed.

events.title: Employee falls from scaffolding and is killed
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Saarman Construction Ltd. Kamuela, HI. At 10:30 a.m. on September 16, 2015, an employee was installing tile. The employee fell from scaffold working level to concrete lanai below. The employeeruptured his spleen and was killed.

events.title: Employee is killed in fall from scaffold
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Ocean Tile Llc. Kamuela, HI. At 10:30 a.m. on September 16, 2015, an employee was installing edging tile while working on a tubular welded scaffolding. As the employee was kneeling down onto the scaffold working level he grabbed onto a midrailing that popped off of the horizontal support and locking pin mechanism. The employee lost his balance and fell 7 feet onto a concrete lanai below, striking the edge of the lanai. The employee was killed as a result of internal bleeding from his injuries. injuries.

events.title: Employee Is Electrocuted While Stripping Live Wire
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Jcc Electric Inc. Waikoloa, HI. On July 22, 2015, an employee was stripping a live energized 120V 12 gauge with non-insulated Milwaukee multi-tool wire strippers and electrocuted themselves wile touching a surface that grounded them, completing the circuit through his body.
